newsitem.title: KAZAKHSTAN: Canadian mining company ships Tajik gold.
newsitem.headline: Canadian mining company ships Tajik gold.

text.p: Canadian-listed mining company Nelson Gold Corporation Ltd said on Monday it had sent 12,700 ounces of production from its Zeravshan mine in war-torn Tajikistan to Switzerland.
"We shipped 12,700 ounces to Switzerland last week," Nelson Gold's vice-president, Andrew King, told Reuters by telephone from London.
Operations at the mine, located in the north of the country near Uzbekistan, were halted in September after a dispute with the Tajik government which stopped Nelson from exporting its production.
"There were a number of problems (with the Tajik government) but through a series of negotiations we managed to resolve them," said King.
King, who said mining would restart sometime this month, estimated Zeravshan's 1997 production at around 30,000 ounces.
The $54 million venture is an important test-case for foreign investment in Tajikistan which has been torn apart by a four-year civil war. --Chris Bird, Almaty Newsroom +7 3272 509410
